title: G5 Sahel Region Country Climate and Development Report
temporal_coverage: Observed development conditions and modeled climate-development risks through mid-century.
methodology: The regional CCDR combines climate projections, macroeconomic and sector analysis, and development diagnostics for the five G5 Sahel countries.
limitations: Many findings are regional; this bank uses them only where Burkina Faso is named or the report explicitly applies the finding across all G5 countries.

title: Updated National Adaptation Plan - Burkina Faso
organization: Government of Burkina Faso and United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change
temporal_coverage: Updated national adaptation planning framework current at March 2025.
methodology: The government planning document consolidates national climate risks, sector priorities, institutions, and proposed adaptation actions.
limitations: A policy plan records priorities and intended actions rather than independently evaluated implementation results.

title: Climate Change and Violent Conflict in West Africa: Assessing the Evidence
temporal_coverage: Academic literature available for the systematic review published in February 2022.
methodology: A systematic literature review assesses four mediated climate-insecurity pathways and the strength of the regional evidence base.
limitations: The review finds a limited research base and does not support deterministic or uniformly national causal claims for Burkina Faso.

title: Countering climate-related security risks in the Sahel
temporal_coverage: Research and stakeholder consultation supporting climate-security strategy development through 2024.
methodology: CGIAR researchers investigated risk pathways and consulted national and regional stakeholders to validate findings and identify policy options.
limitations: This results page summarizes research and consultation rather than publishing the full underlying evidence or evaluation design.

title: Climate change and conflict pursue displaced Burkinabes
organization: United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees
temporal_coverage: Displacement, drought, livelihood, and 2020 flood conditions reported through January 2021.
methodology: A UNHCR field story combines interviews, site observation, government displacement data, and cautious expert interpretation.
limitations: Selected households and sites are not nationally representative; the source explicitly cautions against a direct climate-conflict attribution.

title: Burkina Faso country overview
temporal_coverage: Living country overview with current humanitarian and food-security indicators.
methodology: WFP synthesizes operational monitoring, food-security analysis, displacement context, and program activities.
limitations: A living operational page can change and mixes indicators with different reference dates; program descriptions are not independent evaluations.

title: Evaluation of Burkina Faso WFP Country Strategic Plan 2019-2023
organization: World Food Programme Office of Evaluation
temporal_coverage: WFP activities from January 2018 through July 2022; evaluation conducted April 2022 to January 2023.
methodology: The independent evaluation assessed relevance, strategic positioning, outcome contributions, efficiency, and explanatory factors across the country portfolio.
limitations: The evaluation predates later conflict and climate developments and assesses WFP's portfolio rather than all national response systems.

title: Supporting Local Governments and Building Resilience in Burkina Faso
geographic_coverage: All 13 regions and 349 municipalities of Burkina Faso
temporal_coverage: Local governance program results, with crisis-response results concentrated in August 2020 to September 2021.
methodology: A World Bank results brief reports program monitoring data on decentralization, municipal capacity, service continuity, and assistance to displaced households.
limitations: The implementing institution's results brief is not an independent impact evaluation and some outcomes coincide with COVID-19 response rather than climate action.

title: Promoting peaceful transhumance in the Liptako-Gourma region
organization: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations
geographic_coverage: Liptako-Gourma areas of Burkina Faso, Mali, and Niger
temporal_coverage: Lessons from a joint FAO-IOM Peacebuilding Fund initiative implemented from 2020 to 2024.
methodology: The good-practice product synthesizes implementation lessons from work with farmer organizations and national authorities on transhumance, governance, and cohesion.
limitations: Regional lessons do not isolate Burkina Faso effects or establish independent causal impact.

title: Farming communities in Burkina Faso are improving their agricultural practices with innovative weather tools
temporal_coverage: Hydromet implementation and farmer rain-gauge distribution since 2023.
methodology: A project feature reports administrative monitoring, training coverage, institutional roles, and selected participant accounts.
limitations: The page reports outputs and testimonials rather than independent effectiveness or distributional evaluation.
